notes.title: Toy Odyssey update v20170216
notes.content:
New features:

• [b]Toypedia[/b]: Show details and info of defeated enemies
You can access it via the main menu anytime anywhere. This was not saved beforehand so you need to kill them again to unlock their Toypedia entry.

• [b]Change Appearance[/b]
Add the ability to change the appearance of your outfits once you unlock them.

• [b]Japanese Localization[/b]

Fixes

• [b]Achievement fixes[/b]
Fixed some collection type achievements.

notes.title: Toy Odyssey Update v20161028!
notes.content:
[b][h1]• Toy Odyssey now has Steam Trading Cards![/h1][/b]
[b]• Added support for higher resolutions up to 3840x2160 and 21:9 aspect ratio![/b]
[b]• Craft GUI overhauled with crafting tree.[/b]
• Add a button to view currently equipped item for comparison.
• Add a "Blueprints" button in Backpack screen to view blueprint while venturing.
• Boss-rush mode. Any defeated boss now spawns a door in the base.
• Boss hunting quests now pinpoint the boss location on map.
• Construction build time greatly reduced.
• Various bug fixes

notes.title: Toy Odyssey v20161013 is available!
notes.content:
• Fix some mismatch quest descriptions for the required number on collection quests.
• Diary collection quest now display the correct number of entry.
• Scale down and lower some foreground environments for better viewing of traps, platforms and floor.
• Dash now is instant and cancel any other action.
• Add an option to turn off screen-shake effect for heavy weapons.
• Vastly improve AI of most enemy.
• The Tank now shoots heat-seeking missile.
• Lighten the visited rooms on mini map.
• Additional Improvement on various texts in size and clarity.
• Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Toy Odyssey v20161008 is live with Mac OS X version!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Mac OS X version available![/h1][/b]
• Improve game performance.
• Fixed a glitch where the construction progress bar wouldn’t go away.
• Fixed an issue where “Upgrade available” pop-up was still shown after the player reached the max level.
• Fixed the following achievements: “Great, kid. Don’t get cocky"; "Serial killer"; "Checked-in"; "Junkyard Delight"; "Good luck, have fun".
• Added a “Help” button to view the tutorials again in certain screens.

notes.title: Toy Odyssey Update v20160927 is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Raids now are more balancing![/b][/h1]

   • Raids now will not occur until night 20 or when you've hoarded 5000 nuts, whatever comes first.
   • Builder speed bonus increased.
   • Enemy spawns will less effect raids.
   • Turn on more lights will slightly lower the chance of raids
   • Decrease the ammount of materials lost during a raid.

[h1][b]More Blueprints and Material drops.[/b][/h1]

   • Enemy now drop more materials
   • Challenger chest and Safe now guarantee drop Blueprints/Items.
   • Drop rate of Jewelries and Silverware increased when open Scavenge Point and Locked Container.

[h1][b]Main Quest Objective balancing! All the collection and fetch quests are now require less grinding.[/b][/h1]

   • Quest 5, "Get Ready" now only require 10 of each material.
   • Quest 6, "Arm your self" Iron sword blueprint now drop sooner and much easier to find.
   • Quest 13, "Can't Be Too Prepared" now only require 10 of each material.

[h1][b]Other Changes[/b][/h1]

   • Various texts have been increased in font size.
   • BMG now play for longer period without abruptly fade out.  
   • Fix a bug where the boss "The Hero" fail to continue attacking.
   • Flying droid's icon now display correctly.
   • Fix a corrupted save game data bug which makes Brand invisible.

notes.title: Upcoming patches scheduled!
notes.content:
We're working on an upcoming patch which further balance the game, included:

- Raid mechanic remastered to be more logical and forgiving.
- Balanced crafting with more blueprints and materials drop
- Main Quest objectives balancing.
- Font size increased
- Improve the way BGM plays
- More controllers support


We've also worked hard on a patch for Xbox One, which has already been submitted to Microsoft for approval and review. This will drastically improve balancing issues and build/construction times! Keep an eye out here soon for that fix!

notes.title: Toy Odyssey Update v20160922 has been released!
notes.content:
Major Changes: 
- Balance drop value. All material drop rate have been increased.
- Raid mechanic balance. Raid will not occur until night 20.

General fixes: 
- Fixed bug where Brand got stuck in squat stance.
- Reduced Wall Gun 's sound volume and range.
- Add Next button on Night summary screen.

notes.title: Toy Odyssey có tùy chọn tiếng Việt hoàn chỉnh!
notes.content:
Chào các game thủ Việt Nam! 

Do Steam không cho lựa chọn tiếng Việt là một trong các ngôn ngữ được hỗ trợ khi hiển thị trên store, nên chúng ta không thấy được tiếng Việt trong danh sách ngôn ngữ của game khi nhìn trên trang Steam của Toy Odyssey. 

Tuy vậy trong game vẫn có tùy chọn tiếng Việt hoàn chỉnh, có thể chuyển qua trong Setting/Tùy chỉnh.
